description: AI Silence Remover — Cut pauses from a video or audio recording, with controls for how much space to leave around speech.. AI Studio run — dispatches to our AI workers (Modal). Credits per run vary by model and file size. Day Pass and welcome credits do not include AI Studio. Files are deleted after processing; auditable at mioffice.ai/account/tasks (retention details at mioffice.ai/privacy). All three credit-based workspaces unlock with the same one-time credit pack — there is no per-workspace subscription. See mioffice.ai/pricing for current plans.
name: mio_ai_silence_remover
